correctness.rationale: In the global p12≠0 Grassmannian big cell the unique matrix [[1,0,a,b],[0,1,c,d]] gives p14=d, p23=−a, p34=ad−bc. Setting x=b/a and y=c/d is a regular isomorphism to (C*)²×{xy≠1} with inverse (a,d,x,y)↦(a,ax,dy,d). Alexander duality for the deleted smooth C* curve in C² gives integral homology H0,H1,H2 each Z; torsion-free Künneth yields Betti (1,3,4,3,1). Motivic subtraction gives (L−1)²(L²−L+1) and compactly supported Hodge polynomial (q−1)²(q²−q+1); Euler 0 agrees with the primary table. The coordinate change, rather than finite testing, proves the algebraic assertion.
